title: Port stale-import classification without changing page state
scope: Complete isStaleImport over owned string-message errors, strings, typed CommandError markers and non-error/non-string negatives. Preserve legacy ASCII regex case semantics and host text bounds. No page timestamp or full error normalization in this unit.
acceptance: Full pinned original predicate compares mixed-case, Unicode/UTF16, substring, negative type and typed-error inputs before Rust.
Native boundary tests, source proof and required gates preserve input/state and refuse only distinct host limits.
open_items: Page stale timestamp, staleError construction and full asCommandError normalization are separate continuations.
Error messages are owned UTF16 text; arbitrary mutable JS message coercion/getters and browser preload listener runtime are not represented.
